description: Compact one-row review strip of the document region, shown only when there are pending revisions or open comments: a warning icon, 'Needs review', the counts as a sentence (plural families: Czech says 1 komentář / 3 komentáře / 5 komentářů) and two icon + text buttons that open the revisions or comments panels.

parameters.name: OpenComments
parameters.description: Raised when the comments panel should open.

parameters.name: OpenRevisions
parameters.description: Raised when the revisions panel should open.
